verdict.rationale: Fathom ships a first-party API reference with per-endpoint pages (list meetings, get transcript, get summary, create webhook, list teams), and some pages embed OpenAPI fields such as operationId. A quickstart walks users through making a first call. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable 'try it' examples, and the OpenAPI spec probes returned 404. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable in-page code examples, a publicly fetchable OpenAPI spec, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
